display.purpose: Home launcher + login wordmark. Single instance per screen.

body.purpose: All running text and 13px table cells.

label.purpose: Form input label sitting above the field.

uppercase-label.purpose: Section dividers, table column headers, bucket urgency headers.

mono-numeric.purpose: Every monetary value, count, timestamp. Tabular numerals on.

shadows.name: shadow-sm
shadows.purpose: Default card and sidebar elevation; pairs with 1px border.

shadows.name: focus-ring
shadows.purpose: Input focus glow, paired with accent border.

motion.name: ease-out-cubic-bezier
motion.purpose: Standard ease for button presses, row reveals, drawer slide.

motion.name: duration-base
motion.purpose: Hover state changes, border colour shifts.

components.name: Primary Button
components.description: One per page. The single Deep Operational Blue CTA; carries the page's primary action.
components.css: .ds-btn-primary { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 6px; background: #1e40af; color: #ffffff; border: none; border-radius: 7px; padding: 8px 16px; font-family: 'Inter', sans-serif; font-size: 13px; font-weight: 600; cursor: pointer; box-shadow: 0 1px 4px rgba(30,64,175,.25); transition: transform 120ms cubic-bezier(.16,1,.3,1), background-color 150ms; white-space: nowrap; } .ds-btn-primary:hover { background: #1648c0; transform: translateY(-1px); } .ds-btn-primary:active { transform: translateY(1px) scale(.98); } .ds-btn-primary:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #1e40af; outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Ghost Button
components.description: Workhorse secondary action. White background, accent on hover.
components.css: .ds-btn-ghost { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 6px; background: #ffffff; color: #374151; border: 1px solid #d0d3d9; border-radius: 7px; padding: 8px 16px; font-family: 'Inter', sans-serif; font-size: 13px; font-weight: 600; cursor: pointer; transition: transform 120ms cubic-bezier(.16,1,.3,1), color 150ms, background-color 150ms, border-color 150ms; white-space: nowrap; } .ds-btn-ghost:hover { background: #eff6ff; color: #1e40af; border-color: #1e40af; } .ds-btn-ghost:active { transform: translateY(1px) scale(.98); }

components.name: State Badge (Pending)
components.description: Tinted pill, bordered. State only, never decorative. The four variants share this exact shape; only the colour triad changes (bg / border / text).
components.css: .ds-badge { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 4px; font-family: 'Inter', sans-serif; font-size: 12px; font-weight: 500; padding: 4px 10px; border-radius: 20px; white-space: nowrap; } .ds-badge-amber { background: #fffbeb; color: #d97706; border: 1px solid #fde68a; }

components.name: Text Input
components.description: Default text/date/email input with accent focus ring. Label sits above; helper text below.
components.html: Full legal name as on NID or passport.
components.css: .ds-field { display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 5px; } .ds-field-label { font-family: 'Inter', sans-serif; font-size: 11.5px; font-weight: 600; letter-spacing: .03em; color: #374151; } .ds-input { background: #ffffff; border: 1px solid #d0d3d9; border-radius: 7px; padding: 8px 11px; font-family: 'Inter', sans-serif; font-size: 13.5px; color: #111827; outline: none; width: 100%; transition: border-color 150ms, box-shadow 150ms; } .ds-input::placeholder { color: #9ca3af; font-weight: 400; } .ds-input:focus { border-color: #1e40af; box-shadow: 0 0 0 3px rgba(26,86,219,.1); } .ds-field-help { font-family: 'Inter', sans-serif; font-size: 11px; color: #9ca3af; }

components.name: Card
components.description: Default elevated container. Used for grouping (a dashboard widget, a payroll record). NOT for individual list rows.
components.html:

components.css: .ds-card { background: #ffffff; border: 1px solid #e8eaed; border-radius: 10px; box-shadow: 0 1px 2px rgba(0,0,0,.05); } .ds-card-hdr { padding: 14px 20px; border-bottom: 1px solid #e8eaed; display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 12px; } .ds-card-hdr-icon { width: 32px; height: 32px; background: #eff6ff; border: 1px solid #bfdbfe; border-radius: 8px; color: #1e40af; display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; flex-shrink: 0; } .ds-card-title { font-family: 'Inter', sans-serif; font-size: 14px; font-weight: 600; color: #111827; } .ds-card-sub { font-family: 'Inter', sans-serif; font-size: 12px; color: #9ca3af; margin-top: 1px; } .ds-card-body { padding: 20px; font-family: 'Inter', sans-serif; font-size: 13px; color: #374151; line-height: 1.5; }

components.name: List Row (pay-group-row)
components.description: The signature row pattern. Used across Expiring Documents, Probation, Salary Revisions, Training, Staff Requests. Leading info block (name + detail line) and trailing action cluster. Tight 8px vertical gap between rows; hairline border; no shadow.
components.html:
Aishath Niuma Stage 1
Production - submitted 22 May - 3 days
Awaiting Yoosuf
components.css: .ds-row { display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: space-between; padding: 10px 14px; background: #f8f9fa; border: 1px solid #e8eaed; border-radius: 7px; margin-bottom: 8px; gap: 12px; transition: border-color 150ms; } .ds-row:hover { border-color: #d0d3d9; } .ds-row > div:first-child { min-width: 0; flex: 1 1 auto; } .ds-row-name { font-family: 'Inter', sans-serif; font-size: 13px; font-weight: 600; color: #111827; display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 8px; } .ds-row-detail { font-family: 'Inter', sans-serif; font-size: 12px; color: #9ca3af; margin-top: 2px; } .ds-row-right { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 12px; flex-shrink: 0; } .ds-row-aux { font-family: 'Inter', sans-serif; font-size: 11px; color: #9ca3af; } .ds-badge { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 4px; font-family: 'Inter', sans-serif; font-size: 11px; font-weight: 500; padding: 3px 8px; border-radius: 20px; white-space: nowrap; } .ds-badge-amber { background: #fffbeb; color: #d97706; border: 1px solid #fde68a; } .ds-btn-ghost { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 6px; background: #ffffff; color: #374151; border: 1px solid #d0d3d9; border-radius: 7px; padding: 8px 16px; font-family: 'Inter', sans-serif; font-size: 13px; font-weight: 600; cursor: pointer; } .ds-btn-ghost:hover { background: #eff6ff; color: #1e40af; border-color: #1e40af; }

components.name: Bucket Header
components.description: Urgency band header used on Expiring Documents / Probation / Training. Leading 3px colored pill, then uppercase label, then count. The red variant pulses slowly to read as live status.
components.css: .ds-bucket { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 10px; margin: 0 0 10px; font-family: 'Inter', sans-serif; font-size: 12.5px; font-weight: 700; letter-spacing: .04em; text-transform: uppercase; color: #374151; } .ds-bucket::before { content: ''; display: inline-block; width: 3px; height: 14px; background: currentColor; border-radius: 2px; opacity: .6; } .ds-bucket-count { font-family: 'Inter', sans-serif; font-size: 11px; font-weight: 600; color: #9ca3af; letter-spacing: 0; text-transform: none; } .ds-bucket-red { color: #dc2626; } .ds-bucket-red::before { animation: dsBucketPulse 2.2s ease-in-out infinite; } @keyframes dsBucketPulse { 0%, 100% { opacity: .55; } 50% { opacity: 1; } }

components.description: Always-dark topbar. Frames every authenticated screen. Wordmark on the left, module tab strip in the middle, user pill on the right. Theme-independent.

components.css: .ds-topbar { background: #111827; padding: 0 24px; display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 0; height: 52px; border-bottom: 1px solid rgba(255,255,255,.08); font-family: 'Inter', sans-serif; } .ds-topbar-logo { font-size: 20px; font-weight: 800; color: #fff; letter-spacing: -0.5px; margin-right: 32px; } .ds-topbar-logo span { color: #60a5fa; } .ds-topbar-nav { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 2px; flex: 1; } .ds-tab { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 7px; padding: 8px 14px; border-radius: 7px; font-family: 'Inter', sans-serif; font-size: 13px; font-weight: 500; color: rgba(255,255,255,.6); cursor: pointer; transition: all 150ms; border: none; background: none; } .ds-tab:hover { color: #fff; background: rgba(255,255,255,.07); } .ds-tab-active { color: #fff; background: rgba(255,255,255,.12); } .ds-topbar-user { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 8px; padding: 6px 10px; border-radius: 7px; cursor: pointer; } .ds-topbar-user:hover { background: rgba(255,255,255,.08); } .ds-avatar { width: 30px; height: 30px; border-radius: 50%; background: #1e40af; display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; font-size: 12px; font-weight: 700; color: #fff; } .ds-uname { font-size: 13px; font-weight: 500; color: rgba(255,255,255,.85); } .ds-urole { font-size: 11px; color: rgba(255,255,255,.4); }

narrative.overview: EM HUB is a console, not a canvas. The interface exists to make a busy operations team faster and more correct, not to impress. Aesthetically it sits in the space of utility-first software (Linear's restraint, Stripe Dashboard's tabular precision, Notion's quiet borders) and is deliberately distant from anything that reads as marketing surface, decoration, or trend. The dominant impression should be competent silence: a tool the user stops noticing because it is doing its job. The system uses tinted neutrals on a near-white page background, with a single deep blue accent doing all the work of indicating active state, primary action, and current selection.
keyCharacteristics: Tinted-neutral surfaces with one deep-blue accent (Restrained palette).
Inter throughout; system-font fallback. No display font, no editorial pairing.
Density that follows the data: dense tables, breathing empty states.
Tabular numerals everywhere money or time appears.
Light + dark both first-class; dark slate, never near-black.
Status badges are pill-shaped, tinted, and bordered (low chroma, never neon).
Motion is feedback, not choreography. 120-250ms, ease-out, transform/opacity only.

rules.name: The One Accent Rule
rules.body: Deep Operational Blue is the only colour used decoratively on chrome. All other colour is reserved for state. Hover and selection share the same accent.

rules.name: The Tinted Neutral Rule
rules.body: Every neutral is tinted toward the cool/blue family. #000 and #fff are forbidden as background or text values.

rules.name: The Status Quadrant Rule
rules.body: Every status fits into exactly one of four buckets: green, amber, red, blue. Purple is reserved; not a state. No additional state colours may be introduced.

rules.name: The Tabular Numerals Rule
rules.body: Any column with a number uses font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums. Numbers align to the decimal in tables.

rules.name: The One Family Rule
rules.body: Inter does everything. Adding a display, monospace, or serif companion is a design failure unless it serves a job no Inter cut can do.

rules.name: The Hairline Rule
rules.body: Default cards lift off the page with shadow-sm plus a 1px border. Removing either alone makes the surface read flat or floating.

rules.name: The Mode-Aware Shadow Rule
rules.body: Dark-mode shadows are recalibrated, not just inherited; alpha is heavier (0.3-0.5) to compensate for the smaller luminance gap.

dos: Do use the four-colour state vocabulary (green / amber / red / blue) consistently across every module.
Do use tabular numerals on every numeric column.
Do lead the primary action with the one Deep Operational Blue button. One per page.
Do use the pay-group-row list pattern for any many-items-scan-and-act surface.
Do keep dark mode and light mode visually equivalent.
Do size text inputs at 16px+ on mobile.
Do keep the topbar dark in both themes. It is a frame, not a surface.
Do use inline SVG icons from the established ICON.* library. 14px, stroke 1.75, currentColor.
donts: Don't use a left or right colored stripe greater than 1px on a card, alert, callout, or list item.
Don't introduce glassmorphism, backdrop-blur, neon glow, or pure-black-and-white.
Don't introduce a second font family.
Don't wrap individual list items in cards.
Don't use modals as the first reach.
Don't introduce a new accent or state colour.
Don't animate width, height, top, left, or any layout property.
Don't spin a spinner in the middle of content while loading a list.
Don't use cute illustrations or friendly mascots in empty states.
